steps.en: Add the package to your Node app
steps.zh: 把这个包加进你的 Node 应用

steps.en: npm pulls only your platform's prebuilt engine: native on macOS/Windows, WASM on Linux
steps.zh: npm 只拉本平台的预编译引擎（Linux 上是 WASM）

steps.en: Create a converter, optionally naming your font directories
steps.zh: 创建 converter，可指定字体目录

steps.en: Indexes the fonts it may use and caches their metadata on disk
steps.zh: 索引可用字体，并把字体元数据缓存到磁盘

steps.en: Call render with an absolute input path and a not-yet-existing output path
steps.zh: 调用 render，传入绝对路径的输入和新的输出路径

steps.en: Starts a fresh private engine, writes the PDF, returns the backend used and missing fonts
steps.zh: 新起一个私有引擎写出 PDF，返回所用后端和缺失字体

value.en: Office files become PDFs inside your Node process with no LibreOffice install or soffice babysitting, and you learn which requested fonts were missing
value.zh: 在 Node 进程里把 Office 转成 PDF，不装 LibreOffice、不管 soffice，还知道缺哪些字体

sources: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-libreoffice-kit README.md (Quick start: npm install @deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit@0.1.3, createConverter, converter.render with inputPath/outputPath, result.backend / result.missingFonts; Engines and distribution: native macOS/Windows, WASM on Linux)
packages/entry/README.md (createConverter({ timeoutMs: 120_000 }); each render creates a separate native process or Node worker and private profile; font metadata cache)
